name: Cragspire Falls
description: A mountain stream drops over a cliff into a deep pool. Trout and grayling hold in the cold water, and at dawn and dusk the salmon leap the falls.

discovery.message: Above the roar of the wind you hear falling water, and find a stream thundering down into a pool below the path.

pool.text: The falls thunder into a deep green pool. Spray hangs in the air. Trout hold in the slack water at the edges, and when the light is low, salmon hurl themselves at the falls.

leave.text: You leave the roar of the falls behind.
